label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y hizo cortinas de cabras para tienda sobre el mishkán; once cortinas hizo a ellas.
spanish: Y hizo cortinas de cabras para tienda sobre el tabernáculo; once cortinas hizo a ellas.
grammarChanges: Replaced the transliteration "mishkán" with the Spanish "tabernáculo" for h02036014006 (common noun with article), matching the established rendering of the same construction in the parallel instruction verse.
readerNote: Kept "ellas" to agree in gender with the Spanish noun cortinas rather than with the Hebrew masculine plural suffix on h02036014011, which is the required grammatical agreement in Spanish.
